main_question: First things first — what's your name (or what do people call you)?
And where are you living these days?
What do you do — working, studying, or something in between?
Now for the fun part: pick something you actually want to talk about. Choose one below, or write your own.
Round two — pick another topic (or write your own).
Last one — pick a third topic (or write your own).
Please select an option next to each statement to indicate the extent to which you agree or disagree with that statement: "I see myself as..."

Critical, argumentative.

main_question: Please select the option that shows how much the person in the description is like you.

items.text: Thinking up new ideas and being creative is important to the person. The person likes to do things in their own original way.
It is important for the person to be rich. The person wants to have a lot of money and expensive things.
The person thinks it is important that every person in the world be treated equally. The person believes everyone should have equal opportunities in life.
It's important to the person to show their abilities. The person wants people to admire what they do.
It is important to the person to live in secure surroundings. The person avoids anything that might endanger their safety.
The person likes surprises and is always looking for new things to do. The person thinks it is important to do lots of different things in life.
The person believes that people should do what they're told. The person thinks people should follow rules at all times, even when no-one is watching.
It is important to the person to listen to people who are different from them. Even when the person disagrees with people, it is still important to understand them.
It is important to the person to be humble and modest. The person tries not to draw attention to themselves.
Having a good time is important to the person. The person likes to 'spoil' themselves.
It is important to the person to make their own decisions about what they do. The person likes to be free and not depend on others.
It's very important to the person to help the people around them. The person wants to care for their well-being.
Being very successful is important to the person. The person hopes people will recognize their achievements.
It is important to the person that the government insure their safety against all threats. The person wants the state to be strong so it can defend its citizens.
The person looks for adventures and likes to take risks. The person wants to have an exciting life.
It is important to the person always to behave properly. The person wants to avoid doing anything people would say is wrong.
It is important to the person to get respect from others. The person wants people to do what they say.
It is important to the person to be loyal to their friends. The person wants to devote themselves to people close to them.
The person strongly believes that people should care for nature. Looking after the environment is important to this person.
Tradition is important to the person. The person tries to follow the customs handed down by their religion or their family.
The person seeks every chance they can to have fun. It is important to this person to do things that give them pleasure.
